preconditions.expression: all(line.strip().split() == [N_str] or (line.strip().split() == [i_str, j_str] and int(i_str) >= 1 and int(j_str) >= 1) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: The first line contains an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5), and each subsequent line contains two integers i and j (1 ≤ i, j ≤ 10^9) representing queries.
The total number of lines in stdin is exactly N + 1 (one for N and N for queries).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[k] == str(lca_depth(i, j)) for k in range(N) if k > 0)
postconditions.description: For each query (i, j) at line k+1 (k ≥ 1), the output line k+1 is the length of the shortest path between nodes i and j, which equals the depth difference between their lowest common ancestor (LCA) and each node.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[k]) <= 2 * max_depth(i, j) for k in range(N) if k > 0)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer representing a valid path length between nodes i and j.
